usedFor: A “New Client” in Autopilot signs the client up for a Zoom webinar.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Autopilot, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: “New Client” can be limited to clients or leads, so the right group gets invited.

watchOut: “Updated Client” fires on any change, so one person could be registered twice.
